A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''warrior''' participated in the [[Battle of Caluula]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], and was part of the Yuuzhan Vong party that boarded [[Caluula Station]]. There, he used a [[asth-korr]] throat-hold on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and almost killed him, though the warrior [[Death/Legends|died]] first when his head exploded due to a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Rocket dart/Legends|rocket dart]].
